--- gql_braced_ambiguity_exists_paren.sql
-- Regression: EXISTS(...) SQL subquery must still parse after EXISTS { gql } support.
EXISTS(SELECT 1)
--- AST
&ast.ExistsSubQuery{
  Exists: 87,
  Rparen: 102,
  Query:  &ast.Select{
    Select:  94,
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.ExprSelectItem{
        Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 101,
          ValueEnd: 102,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
EXISTS(SELECT 1)
